meta.title: A numeric reminder kind crashes
gaps: The plan does not verify the exact HTTP 422 status or an error code because no numeric reminder-type error code is provided.
The plan does not verify that no reminder row or email was created.

steps: The buyer sends the reminders send reminder request, the request the case itself writes.
